articles.title: GnosisDAO approves Gnosis Chain for Ethereum Economic Zone
articles.snippet: Gnosis Chain was approved to transition to an EEZ rollup, enabling it to settle directly to Ethereum rather than continue with an independent validator set.

articles.title: Rushed CLARITY Act vote could set legislation back, Gallego warns
articles.snippet: Senator Ruben Gallego said the White House has not provided point-by-point feedback on a bipartisan ethics proposal as a September vote approaches.

articles.title: Trump pushes for CLARITY Act passage alongside crypto leaders
articles.snippet: Donald Trump spoke from the White House on Wednesday, urging the Senate to pass a crypto market structure bill to keep the country “ahead of China.”

articles.title: FalconX, Ethena bring USDe backing assets into $1B institutional credit facility
articles.snippet: The $1 billion facility will deploy assets backing USDe into overcollateralized institutional loans, expanding Ethena’s sources of returns beyond crypto basis strategies.

articles.title: SEC regulatory proposal marks ‘important’ step forward from ‘inapt’ crypto rules: Commissioner Peirce
articles.snippet: “Crypto mom” Hester Peirce praised the SEC’s proposed crypto regime, published days after the Senate failed to pass the CLARITY Act, the US’ first comprehensive industry framework.
